sonnet.problem: The story card says 'the writer isn't done with that sentence yet' right before the true/false card about whether we are His house whether or not we hold firmly. That signals a condition and points to the answer (False). It also tells verse 6 as an unconditional 'we get to BE His house' without the 'if'.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The right answer 'Exhort one another daily' is the BSB's own wording and sounds more like the Bible. The wrong answers are plain and modern ('Gather together once a year', 'Pray alone every morning'), so the right one stands out.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

sonnet.problem: Card 7 already asked about the oath that they would never enter His rest, and card 18 asks the same fact again (verse 11 and verse 18 make the same point).
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
